challenge.name: The Locked Shadow
challenge.description: A supplier contract for the next promotion week is already signed, and the team cannot deploy the new model without a shadow run to verify it. #reliability_ruth# demands a fully automated and governed shadow environment to protect the live forecast, while #automation_alex# insists on keeping it manual to avoid breaking the current pipeline stability.

output.content: I have reviewed the operational constraints for the upcoming promotion week. The supplier contract is already locked, so we cannot risk destabilizing the live forecast pipeline by forcing a full automation upgrade on the shadow environment right now. I am willing to accept that the shadow run remains a manual process for this cycle. The trade off is clear: we give up the speed and consistency of automated tooling for the shadow checks, but we gain the necessary time to implement the formal governance sign offs. As long as the manual steps are fully governed and auditable, I will not block the deployment on the basis of automation levels alone. This keeps us compliant while we prepare the infrastructure for future cycles.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are willing to accept the loss of speed and consistency in the shadow environment in exchange for the time needed to implement governance sign-offs.
